record.title: National Strategy for Artificial Intelligence until 2030 (NsUI 2030)
record.original_title: Nacionalna strategija za umetno inteligenco do leta 2030 (NsUI 2030)
record.notes: Adopted by the Government on 5 March 2026 as successor to the national programme NpUI 2025, adopted in May 2021; the Government instructed the Ministry of Digital Transformation to prepare an action plan with measures, a schedule and financial resources within nine months. The strategy sets ten guiding principles, five strategic objectives and six horizontal building blocks, and names the Ministry of Digital Transformation as its national manager, with an interministerial coordination group, a Government Council for AI and an AI observatory. Its draft was in public consultation for 30 days from 17 November 2025, and the final draft was scheduled for the Economic and Social Council on 16 January 2026. For fundamental-rights impact assessment it refers to the Council of Europe's methodology for human rights, democracy and the rule of law.

verification.note: Recheck of 17 Oct 2026: re-read the strategy PDF stored from gov.si on 12 Oct 2026 (102 pages, marked 'končna', final; unchanged on 17 Oct) and the Government's Slovenian news release of 5 March 2026 stored the same day, and stored on 17 Oct 2026 the Government's English translation of the strategy (108 pages) and its English release on the 193rd session of 5 March 2026. The PDF confirms the principles, objectives, building blocks, the HG5 measures 5.1-5.5, the governance structure and the preparation timeline; the English release confirms adoption on 5 March 2026, the English title and the nine-month deadline for the action plan; the English PDF uses the same title with the acronym NSAI 2030 and names no translator. The original title in version 1 ('strategija umetne inteligence') appears only in the release's web address; the release and the PDF use 'strategija za umetno inteligenco'. Version 1's endorsement date by the Economic and Social Council rested on a news title that was not stored, and the separate annex on vulnerable groups was not stored; both were removed from the notes.

changes.original_title: the Government's release and the strategy itself call it 'Nacionalna strategija za umetno inteligenco do leta 2030 (NsUI 2030)'; version 1's wording appears only in the release's web address
changes.title: set to the Government's own English title, 'National Strategy for Artificial Intelligence until 2030 (NsUI 2030)', as in its English release; the English translation uses the same title with the acronym NSAI 2030
changes.notes: rewritten: the Economic and Social Council date (from an unstored news title) replaced by the preparation timeline in the strategy's Annex 2; the nine-month action-plan deadline and the governance bodies added; the vulnerable-groups annex and the research-process remark removed
changes.english_version: the Government published an English translation on gov.si under the Ministry of Digital Transformation's documents

judgment.status_reasoning: The Government adopted the strategy on 5 March 2026 (release of that date); the stored PDF is the final version ('končna'). It is a non-binding strategic framework to be implemented through action plans, and no replacement appears. 'Published (non-binding, current)' stands.
judgment.scope_reasoning: National AI strategy whose goals and ethics-and-regulation building block cover AI Act implementation, fundamental-rights impact assessment, security testing and an AI ethics council; in scope with no note.
judgment.date_reasoning: date_published is the Government's adoption on 5 March 2026, from its English and Slovenian releases; the PDF has no date of its own.
